request.trace_artifact.scope: Real Claude Code and Codex token/timing records; no prompt text or ground-truth cross-session KV identity.

request.trace_cardinality.scope: Counts are queried from the pinned artifact rather than copied from an older paper draft.

request.sampling_unit.value: provider-session stratified by provider and session-round-count bin
request.sampling_unit.scope: Session, not round, is the independent resampling unit; seeds select disjoint deterministic samples only probabilistically.

request.arrival_model.value: controlled Poisson session starts plus capped observed within-session gaps
request.arrival_model.scope: This is a load-controlled time-compressed replay, not TraceLab fixed-schedule replay or a production arrival claim.

request.gap_cap.value: 30000 ms cap and 1.0 scale in the primary workload
request.gap_cap.scope: Long human/tool pauses are intentionally capped; uncapped fixed-schedule replay remains a required external-validity check.

request.context_projection.value: rank-preserving scale followed by clipping at 8192/16384/32768/40960 total-token contexts
request.context_projection.scope: Projected Qwen3-compatible workload; it must not be called unmodified TraceLab replay.

request.controlled_fork_join.scope: Mechanism stress topology, not an observed TraceLab DAG and not a Pythia trace reproduction.

request.agentx_external_validity.value: full 393-workflow AgentX/Weka JSONL; SHA256 29b6a19e751ff5230771519aab755f80a0f43a4ba9cf96b72d3a6a437ec99276; recorded intra-workflow request schedule; 20 workflows in ten disjoint two-workflow paper partitions from the 27 observed parallel DAGs with at most 128 requests
request.agentx_external_validity.scope: Observed public multi-agent workflow topology, timing, token counts, and prefix hashes. Workflows are not truncated, but the at-most-128-request eligibility filter excludes long DAGs to keep complete event-level Aegis protection simulation tractable; workflow interleaving and Qwen3 token projection remain controlled choices.

request.causal_slack_prediction.value: five-fold workflow-disjoint dual-head GBDT plus workflow-maximum split conformal 95-percent interval; late or unavailable tickets fail close to zero
request.causal_slack_prediction.scope: Only request-return-prefix features are admitted. Oracle actual remaining time is retained for held-out scoring only and never enters a runtime Slack ticket.

request.uncertainty.value: 10 seeds for S1-S4/S6-S8 and E1, 5 for S5, 3 formula-verification seeds for S9
request.uncertainty.scope: Two-sided Student-t 95 percent CIs use seed-level aggregates; within-seed sessions are paired observations.

failure.type.scope: AegisKV protects state loss after hard worker failure; fail-slow and silent corruption are outside this experiment contract.

failure.conditional_trigger.value: policy-independent shadow-schedule active critical tail at the 0.5 quantile
failure.conditional_trigger.scope: Conditional-on-failure estimand chosen to exercise recovery; not a field failure-time distribution.

failure.count_and_domain.scope: Covers single failures, increasing failed-worker counts, and a correlated domain failure.

failure.capacity_restoration_horizon.scope: 30 seconds is anchored to LUMEN's 29.9-second failure-impact window; it is not asserted as a hardware repair distribution.

failure.failover_delay.value: 100 ms replacement delay and 50 ms routing outage
failure.failover_delay.scope: Controlled failover decomposition near FailSafe's 120 ms full-recovery example, but not same-topology Qwen/A100 calibration.

failure.field_hazard.scope: Central value is 400 A100 days times 24; Meta's all-cause training-job MTTF gives an 8089.6 GPU-hour order-of-magnitude cross-check. Both are training-cluster proxies, not inference field measurements.

deployment.node_topology.value: 4 nodes, 8 NVIDIA A100-40GB GPUs per node
deployment.node_topology.scope: Modeled 32-GPU DGX A100 deployment; the currently available 2xA100-80GB host is not topology-equivalent.

deployment.host_memory.value: 1024 GiB installed and 512 GiB assigned to AegisKV per node
deployment.host_memory.scope: Installed memory is a DGX specification; the 50-percent AegisKV allocation is a conservative design budget, not a measured production reservation.

deployment.model_geometry.value: Qwen3-8B: 36 layers; Qwen3-32B: 64 layers; both 8 KV heads x 128 dimensions, BF16, 40960 default positions
deployment.model_geometry.scope: KV byte footprints are derived directly from the pinned model geometry.

deployment.kv_bytes.value: 147456 bytes/token for Qwen3-8B and 262144 bytes/token for Qwen3-32B
deployment.kv_bytes.scope: 2 for K/V times layers times KV heads times head dimension times 2 BF16 bytes.

deployment.parallel_layout.scope: Qwen3-32B BF16 weights cannot fit on one A100-40GB; TP4 leaves explicit HBM headroom.

deployment.network_line_rate.scope: Line rate is not treated as application payload throughput.

deployment.effective_transfer_bandwidth.scope: 20 GB/s is below the 25 GB/s conversion of 200 Gbit/s line rate and near pinned host-device measurements; it remains a modeled end-to-end effective rate.

deployment.diagnostic_bandwidths.value: 270 GB/s same-node peer and 22.5 GB/s pinned host-device
deployment.diagnostic_bandwidths.scope: Diagnostic bounds only; same-node peer bandwidth is not used for cross-node failure-domain-separated recovery.

deployment.hbm_protection_budget.value: 6 GiB per 8B replica and 24 GiB per 32B TP4 replica
deployment.hbm_protection_budget.scope: Six GiB per GPU is a protection budget chosen after accounting for BF16 weights and KV geometry; it is not a vendor default.

deployment.chunking.value: 4096-token prefix and 256-token decode chunks by default; S9 uses an explicit 1024-token prefix micro-verification override
deployment.chunking.scope: The default exactly follows current_design.md. S9 is a labeled analytical-versus-DES transfer micro-verification and is not used to claim the default production chunk size.

deployment.service_time.scope: Largest paper-readiness blocker: coefficients require same-topology A100 profiling and matched physical replay.

deployment.control_policy.value: one-second AIMD window, alpha 0.1-0.9, multiplicative decrease 0.5, additive increase 0.05 after three stable windows
deployment.control_policy.scope: Mechanism parameters are evaluated by trajectory and ablation; they are not claimed as universal production defaults.
